projects.name: xScale builds
projects.quote: The company currently has 53 major projects underway across 40 metros in 24 countries, including 11 xScale builds that are expected to deliver approximately 90 megawatts of capacity once opened.

projects.name: Lisbon IBX data center build
projects.quote: In Q2, Equinix added 12 new projects including new International Business Exchange™ (IBX ®) data center builds in Lisbon, Monterrey and Mumbai—in addition to the company's first build in Kuala Lumpur, one of the most strategic markets in Asia.
